lines.speaker: Alya
lines.text_ms: Encik Rahman, projek dah siap dibina. Kenapa kita masih perlu jaga taman ni setiap minggu?

lines.speaker: Encik Rahman
lines.text_ms: Sebab membina dan mengekalkan landskap dua benda berbeza, Alya. Tumbuhan kena disiram, dibaja dan dikawal perosak. Guna IPM, dan racun kimia pilihan terakhir. Struktur pula perlu dipantau supaya kekal berfungsi.

lines.speaker: Alya
lines.text_ms: Dan semua kena direkod untuk tempoh DLP?

lines.speaker: Encik Rahman
lines.text_ms: Ya. Penyelenggaraan berjadual dan dokumentasi lengkap, itu yang melindungi kerja pembinaan kita dan mencerminkan kualiti kontraktor.

authority_critique_addressed: Alya was too passive — she now opens with a challenge rather than a blank question.
Encik Rahman was reading a list — he now gives the principle and the reason.
The core learning was missing — watering, fertilising and IPM with chemical control last are now in the dialogue.
The close was passive — it now lands on impact: protecting the construction work and reflecting contractor quality.

banned_framing.rule: No soft-versus-hard landscape comparison in the dialogue.
banned_framing.authority_quote: elak framing "beza lembut vs kejur" — modul cuma terangkan dua-dua secara berasingan, tak buat perbandingan

points.text_ms: Penjagaan dan penyelenggaraan memastikan landskap yang telah dibina kekal sihat, berfungsi dan selamat dalam jangka masa panjang. Membina dan mengekalkan landskap adalah dua tanggungjawab berbeza.

Penjagaan dan penyelenggaraan merangkumi landskap lembut dan landskap kejur. Landskap lembut memfokuskan kepada penyiraman, pembajaan dan kawalan racun, manakala landskap kejur memfokuskan kepada memastikan elemen binaan kekal berfungsi dan selamat.

Dengan melaksanakan penjagaan dan penyelenggaraan yang berjadual dan terancang, kontraktor dapat memelihara kualiti landskap sepanjang DLP, memenuhi kewajipan kontrak, dan memastikan ruang luaran kekal lestari dan bernilai untuk pengguna.

authority_critique_addressed: The draft was a four-item list, not a flowing recap.
It was too technical and repeated detail the learner had just covered.
It had no importance beat to open with and no benefit beat to close on.

quiz_global_rules.title_ms: Buang atribusi 'yang dinyatakan dalam modul' daripada soalan kuiz
quiz_global_rules.title_en: Remove module-attribution phrasing from quiz stems
quiz_global_rules.authority_quote: Global keseluruhan kursus – buang "yang dinyatakan dalam modul"
quiz_global_rules.rule: A quiz stem must ask the question directly. It must not attribute its content to the module — no 'yang dinyatakan dalam modul', no 'mengikut modul', no 'Modul menyenaraikan'.
quiz_global_rules.enforcement: Every T04 stem is checked against the banned phrases by a gate. Units outside T04 are out of this stage's scope and are not modified here.

quiz_global_rules.title_ms: Gunakan kotak, bukan A B C, bagi soalan Multiple Response
quiz_global_rules.title_en: Multiple Response options use checkboxes, not letter labels
quiz_global_rules.authority_quote: Global keseluruhan kursus. Jangan gunakan A B C .. untuk pilihan, kerana ini ialah multiple response question. Cadangan - Gunakan kotak.
quiz_global_rules.rule: A Multiple Response item presents its options as checkboxes. Letter labels A, B, C … are reserved for single-answer items, where they signal that exactly one option is chosen.
quiz_global_rules.enforcement: A gate asserts no Multiple Response option in T04 carries a letter label, and that all four MCQ items keep theirs.

do_not_reuse_items.label: Pengurusan Stok dan Penyimpanan (Baja)
do_not_reuse_items.visual_difference: Penyimpanan baja (kering, selamat, jauh dari air) berbeza daripada penyimpanan racun (berkunci, berlabel, berpengudaraan).
do_not_reuse_items.instructional_ground: Learners must not confuse the two PPE sets or the two storage regimes; a shared visual would blur a distinction the learner is expected to make.
do_not_reuse_items.production_ground: The two visuals differ substantially in content, so a shared asset would not in fact save production effort.

do_not_reuse_items.label: Keselamatan Pekerja (Baja)
do_not_reuse_items.visual_difference: PPE untuk baja (sarung tangan, topeng muka) berbeza daripada PPE untuk racun (topeng pernafasan, cermin mata, sarung tangan kimia, sut pelindung).
do_not_reuse_items.instructional_ground: Learners must not confuse the two PPE sets or the two storage regimes; a shared visual would blur a distinction the learner is expected to make.
do_not_reuse_items.production_ground: The two visuals differ substantially in content, so a shared asset would not in fact save production effort.

do_not_reuse_items.label: Keselamatan dan Kesihatan (HSE) (Racun — pematuhan)
